test_output_summary: All 31 new tests passed (voice_errors_test.dart: 12 tests, voice_api_test.dart: 19 tests). All 44 existing tests continue to pass, confirming no regression.
implementation_notes:
Implemented the VoiceApi port as a sibling to SessionApi, following the existing patterns:

1. Extended app/lib/domain/errors.dart with six voice error types (UnsupportedAudioFormat, EmptyRecording, UnintelligibleQuery, QueryTooLong, RecordingTooLarge, VoiceUnavailable) as sealed final classes extending SessionApiException.

2. Created app/lib/ports/voice_api.dart with:
   - VoiceApi interface: three methods (voiceTurn, voiceTurnStream, fetchAudioChunk)
   - VoiceTurnResult DTO: transcript + ordered answer parts
   - AnswerPart sealed hierarchy: TextAnswerPart and AudioAnswerPart with seq ordering
   - VoiceTurnEvent sealed hierarchy: TranscriptEvent, TextTokenEvent, AudioPartEvent, TurnCompleteEvent
   - All DTOs are immutable with const constructors, equality operators, and hashCode

3. Zero new runtime dependencies beyond dart:typed_data (as required).

4. SessionApi and HttpSessionApi remain completely unchanged (frozen-contract invariant verified via git diff).

5. Tests follow the invariant-not-snapshot principle:
   - Exhaustiveness checks via switch statements (compile-time enforcement)
   - Error type string matching
   - DTO equality and immutability
   - No point-in-time boundary assertions (no NotImplementedError checks, no empty-table checks)
